plugins.name: arnaud-zg
plugins.description: Arnaud Zheng's Agent Skills. hexagonal-skill-builder writes Agent Skills and checks them against four rules a script can hold: named, small, resolves, tested. doc-compass writes Diataxis documentation from templates and keeps it true, with a check for orphan pages, broken links and anchors, and stale decision records. radical-simplify rebuilds a process, product or UI into its simplest version: Question, Remove, Simplify, Reimagine, Accelerate, Automate. glance-first presents any work so a reader gets it in under a minute: the answer, the key numbers, then a diagram per block, checked by a script. Every finding comes with its file, line and fix.
